description: Mono frames of long windows with the same spectrum and a TNS filter of order 12 (twice) and 13, 20 and 31 over 30 bands, whose first 12 coefficients are the same: the standard limits the order to 12 and decodes the first 12 coefficients, so the last four blocks decode alike; the field allows more, so the stream is reported.
findings: a TNS filter of a higher order than the 12 its window allows

skip.decode: ffmpeg refuses a TNS filter of an order above 12 ("TNS filter order ... is greater than maximum").
skip.faad_trace: faad2 does not trace the filter's order.
